tagline.en: Echo-Memory's balanced state-space memory setting — a five-frame context, updated every fourth step, with a long hint of 81.
tagline.zh: Echo-Memory 均衡型状态空间记忆配置——五帧上下文、每四步更新一次,并配一段长度为 81 的长 hint。

en: Echo-Memory is a memory-augmented world model on the open Wan2.1 diffusion backbone. From a starting image, a text prompt and a camera trajectory it rolls out video of an explorable scene, using a memory mechanism to hold the scene together over long rollouts.

This identity tunes the state-space memory (SSM) module toward a middle ground: a wide five-frame context like the most attentive variant, but refreshed only every fourth step to keep the update cost down, paired with a longer hint length of 81. That combination keeps a rich memory state while spacing out how often it's rewritten.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint, assembled from shared Wan components. It's aimed at memory research and interactive world-model experiments where you want a wide context without paying to update it every step.
zh: Echo-Memory 是构建在开源 Wan2.1 扩散骨干上的记忆增强世界模型。它以起始图像、文字提示词和相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频,并用记忆机制在长程推演中维持场景连贯。
本模型把状态空间记忆(SSM)模块调向折中:采用与最勤勉变体相同的五帧宽上下文,但只每四步刷新一次以压低更新成本,并搭配长度为 81 的更长 hint。这一组合既保留了丰富的记忆状态,又拉开了记忆被改写的间隔。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一扩散 pipeline、配合本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 运行它,配方由共享 Wan 组件组装而成。它面向记忆机制研究与交互式世界模型实验,适合想要宽上下文、又不愿为逐步更新付出代价的场景。

whenToUse.en: Reach for it when you want a wide five-frame memory context but a lower update frequency, or when studying how hint length interacts with context size in an SSM world model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要五帧宽的记忆上下文、又希望更新频率更低,或研究 hint 长度与上下文大小在 SSM 世界模型中如何相互作用时,选它。

notFor.en: Updating only every fourth step trades away some of the step-by-step tracking the every-1 variant offers. Different hint and update settings suit different studies, so compare across the SSM line. You supply a compatible local checkpoint.
notFor.zh: 只每四步更新一次,会舍弃 every-1 变体那种逐步追踪的一部分能力。不同的 hint 与更新设置适合不同的研究,建议在 SSM 系列间横向比较。你需自备兼容的本地 checkpoint。

en: Balanced state-space memory: 5-frame context, update every 4 steps, hint 81
